status: Qualified exact encoded-storage reduction; original motion and review status preserved.

geometry_vertex_mapping.rule: All original node/primitive vertex ordering and topology retained.

rig_audit.decision: No surviving rigid/zero islands; original skin/rig data retained. Exact redundant key rows only.

exact_source_validation.proof: Zero defaults and every LINEAR/STEP key zero prove inactive targets remain zero continuously and under crossfades. All retained accessor bytes and retained time/value rows are exact. Deleted key rows sit strictly inside three bit-identical adjacent rows; plateau boundaries and endpoints remain.

numeric_all_key_validation.scope: Independent source/candidate sampler evaluation at every original key and midpoint plus off-grid times, including skinning and morph normals; exact interval proof retained separately.

original_physical_witness_validation.scope: Private source-only observations frozen from the immutable original BEFORE the first candidate pack. No earlier authored fixture or artistic approval found. Source curve/data proof, fresh Blender, actual native/editor playback, full-cycle graphics and seeded effects independently check equivalence.

vertex_identity.normal_scope: Recorded only; Blender custom-normal packing is not the authority for source/Godot shading. Vertex motion identity is proved by basis,UV,skin and every POSITION shape.

baseline.binding_method: Full original GLB primitive vertex order, independently proved against basis/UV/skin/normals/all POSITION target data; frozen source IDs retained through partition mapping.
baseline.scope: Independent fresh Blender import geometry/motion witness check. Blender is not the authority for runtime morph normal shading.

vertex_identity.normal_scope: Recorded only; Blender custom-normal packing is not the authority for source/Godot shading. Vertex motion identity is proved by basis,UV,skin and every POSITION shape.

candidate.binding_method: Full original GLB primitive vertex order, independently proved against basis/UV/skin/normals/all POSITION target data; frozen source IDs retained through partition mapping.
candidate.scope: Independent fresh Blender import geometry/motion witness check. Blender is not the authority for runtime morph normal shading.

direct_fresh_blender_comparison.scope: Direct source/candidate frozen-ID surfaces and every bone matrix at each original witness pose plus controlled neutral/default pose. Sixteen float32 ULPs at baseline coordinate/matrix magnitude; independent of inherited source/witness residual and separate from native/source appearance budgets.

native_runtime_validation.scope: Actual imported Godot mesh arrays, native-library sampled poses and crossfades or mounted gait samples, renderer activation cutoff, linear blended skin; image rendering remains a separate check.

fresh_editor_imported_validation.scope: Actual Godot mesh arrays, every native clip and directed crossfade pair, renderer morph activation cutoff, linear blended four/eight-influence skin. Pixel rendering remains a separate check.

actual_actor_dissolve_validation.scope: Real Forward+ renderer. Immutable original code/source compared to updated code/original and updated code/final candidate: complete320instance packed ash transforms/colors/custom-data and body bounds/grain identical per seed; actual override reset verified. Five fade phases compared.

editor_import_policy.scope: Explicit isolated QA import policy for both original and candidate. Preserves float geometry, named skins, original30Hz native cadence and disables animation optimizer/compression. No production import file or loader setting changed.
editor_import_policy.policy_template: armadillo.glb.import params; only animation/fps changed to30 to match original rawGLTF runtime default.

full_motion_source_fit.scope: Every vertex at every full-cycle render frame and view-still pose, using actual complete Actor Godot arrays/poses/weights/transforms, renderer morph cutoff and four/eight influence skin. Evaluated in float64 with a separate 30% camera margin.

pixel_comparison.scope: Complete ReplicatedActor3D setup with actual display scale, grounding and body materials; identical cameras for source/candidate, four views and every full native cycle at24Hz. Numeric playback and pixel comparisons are separate reports.

visual_review: Paired gameplay full-cycle boards (including original Fly where present) and gameplay/side/rear/underside source/candidate views reviewed. Shapes, posed motion, materials and placement agree; all512px frame comparisons pass strict caps with zero border foreground. Original artistic review status and observations retained; no new artistic approval inferred.

media.scope: Exactoriginal512pxPNGs verified inlosslessZIP; losslessWebP pairedpreviews resized384px at24fps preserveallcycleframes forreview.

checks.native_and_imported_playback: 296 states each including RESET and every directed clip crossfade

qualification_limits.position_extent_definition: max(abs(original rest world vertices), largest original rest axis extent)
qualification_limits.position_metric: Total source/candidate Euclidean distance; no inherited/additional-error waiver.

runtime_tradeoff.interpretation: Encoded GLB data shrinks. Original glTF importer FPS is unchanged and rebakes dense runtime curves; file savings do not establish lower retained animation RAM or frame time. Corrective GPU buffers, draw surfaces, bones and influence count are unchanged. Loading cost not benchmarked here.

raw_development_preference: User accepts small RLCZ packaged increases for smaller source models.

source_only_witness_provenance.approval: No artistic approval; preserves the original model and motion as observed.
